introduction: Minnesota SNAP adds money to an EBT account for groceries. Counties and Tribal Nations handle applications and interviews.
description: Minnesota SNAP adds money to an EBT account for groceries. Counties and Tribal Nations handle applications and interviews.

sections.who: Household size and income affect eligibility. The state’s income guidelines changed October 1, 2026; other rules can also apply.
sections.get: Monthly food benefits depend on income, expenses and household size. Expedited assistance may be available.

sections.apply:
1. Apply

    Use MNbenefits, or send the state’s paper application to your county or Tribal Nation.

  2. Complete the interview

    The local office interviews applicants by phone or in person.

  3. Send requested proof

    Save submission receipts and promptly respond to verification requests.
sections.after: Approved applicants receive an EBT card. Follow reporting instructions and renewal dates.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Minnesota SNAP eligibility and application. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
